page.content:
Blue tang with short-term memory loss who still finds the way.

How Dory connects

  • Work: Finding Nemo — Dory partners Marlin through Finding Nemo.
  • Character: Marlin — Dory keeps Marlin moving across the ocean.
  • Faction: Clownfish family — Dory joins Marlin and Nemo as family.

What is Dory?

Dory is the forgetful tang who joins Marlin, speaks whale, and later gets her own film as a member of this ocean family.

Key threads lead to Finding Nemo, Marlin and Clownfish family.
